offers.title: Early Booking Bonus on 2028–29 sailings
offers.why: New itineraries have the widest choice of cabins on opening day, including connecting cabins for families and the few accessible ones.

offers.title: Universal Kids Resort Explorer Ticket and Annual Passes
offers.terms: Explorer Ticket valid Sunday to Thursday through Mar 11, 2027; blockout dates apply; parking not included. Annual Passes offered in Gold, Silver and Silver with Parking. Supplier terms apply.
offers.why: A good fit for families with younger kids who want several relaxed days at a family-sized park. Ask me what works for your group, including sensory-friendly or accessible needs.

offers.title: Princess Hotels Fall & Winter Sale, up to 42% off
offers.terms: Fall and winter stays at Princess Hotels & Resorts in Punta Cana and Riviera Maya, savings of up to 42%. Supplier terms apply.
offers.why: Beach resort getaways in Punta Cana and Riviera Maya at a lower rate for the cooler months. Good for families and couples who want sun without the long flight.

offers.title: Europe 2028–29 sailings now open
offers.why: The best cabins on new Europe itineraries go early. I can hold one while you decide on the rest.

offers.title: Sandals last-minute: one night free
offers.terms: One night free on select last-minute stays at 11 Sandals resorts, travel dates Oct 24 to Nov 27, 2026; combinable with current percent-off savings; varies by resort, dates and availability. Supplier terms apply.
offers.why: A good fit if you can get away on short notice and want an easy all-inclusive Caribbean break with a bonus night. Ask me which resort has your dates and whether you need an accessible room.

offers.title: The Great Jamaica Comeback Sale
offers.terms: Added value at three newly reimagined Sandals resorts in Jamaica, plus an air credit and a complimentary local experience; limited-time offer, varies by resort, dates and availability. Supplier terms apply.
offers.why: A good fit if you want an easy all-inclusive Caribbean beach week with extra value built in. Ask me which Jamaica resort suits your group and whether you need an accessible room.

offers.title: Up to 30% off Universal Orlando hotels
offers.terms: Minimum 5-night stay, travel Sep 8, 2026 to Mar 15, 2027 (some dates excluded); limited availability. Supplier terms apply.
offers.why: A good fit for families planning a theme park trip around the holidays, which run Nov 14 to Jan 3. Ask me about room types and what works for your group, including accessible or sensory-friendly needs.
